# Recall on modern LLM essays

*Generated by `python -m untell.bench.modern_recall` from [modern-llm-smollm2.json](modern-llm-smollm2.json); do not edit by hand.*

60 essays written by `HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct` (sampled, temperature 0.8, seeds recorded per essay) answering the same 15 PERSUADE 2.0 assignments the held-out human essays answer, prompted as a US student in grades 6–12. Each essay is scored as generated and with Markdown scaffolding (headings, bold, bullets) stripped, the way a pasted submission looks.

| detector | threshold | recall, as generated | recall, Markdown stripped | AUROC vs PERSUADE human (stripped) |
|---|---|---|---|---:|
| untell full tier (calibrated-v3) | 5% fit FPR | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) | – |
| fakespot-ai/roberta-base-ai-text-detection-v1 | 0.5 (default) | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) | 1.000 |
| fakespot-ai/roberta-base-ai-text-detection-v1 | 0.5381 (fitted) | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) |  |
| openai-community/roberta-large-openai-detector | 0.5 (default) | 90% (54/60; 95% CI 80–95%) | 90% (54/60; 95% CI 80–95%) | 0.994 |
| openai-community/roberta-large-openai-detector | 0.1372 (fitted) | 97% (58/60; 95% CI 89–99%) | 97% (58/60; 95% CI 89–99%) |  |
| PirateXX/AI-Content-Detector | 0.5 (default) | 87% (52/60; 95% CI 76–93%) | 87% (52/60; 95% CI 76–93%) | 0.995 |
| PirateXX/AI-Content-Detector | 0.0188 (fitted) | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) |  |
| desklib/ai-text-detector-v1.01 | 0.5 (default) | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) | 100% (60/60; 95% CI 94–100%) | 1.000 |

Recall is the share of these AI essays flagged. Compare with each detector's false-positive rates on human writing in the [open-detector leaderboard](open-detectors.md) and [calibration](calibration.md): a recall figure means nothing without the false-flag rate paid for it.

## Caveats

- One small open model (`HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct`). Frontier chat models write differently; this measures whether a detector generalises past its training text, not how it does on any particular commercial model.
- Median essay length 393 words; 17 of 60 essays hit the generation cap and end mid-sentence.
- 0 of 60 used Markdown headings, bold or bullets; the stripped column removes them.
- AUROC compares these essays with student essays on the same prompts; it can be inflated by differences in polish that have nothing to do with authorship.
